title: Finite geometric stalks make nonempty local models finite
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a finite commutative ring. Let F be a fixed-coefficient pro-etale module sheaf which is locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] and whose fixed-module geometric stalk at every algebraically closed field-valued point of X is finite [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Then there is a scheme pro-etale covering W_i → X [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] on which the inverse image of F is the constant sheaf of a finite module M_i [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

source.place: Tag 099Y, proof of lemma-compare-locally-constant; Finite geometric stalks make nonempty local models finite

proof.text: Convert the site covering to a scheme covering. Discard empty members. Quasi-compactness remains true: take a finite affine refinement over each compact open and discard its empty members.

On each remaining member choose an algebraic closure of a residue field. Its geometric fiber identifies the local constant model with the global geometric stalk, using sheafFiberOverIso and sheafFiberConstantSheafIso. Thus the model is finite.
Transport the slice constant-model isomorphism through the slice sheaf equivalence and upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction to obtain the stated scheme inverse-image model.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_models_of_fixed_lisse
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : IsLocallyConstantProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf X Λ F ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
        (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
        Finite (proEtaleGeometricFixedModuleStalk x Λ F)) :
    ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty (((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (g i)).obj F) ≅
            (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (W i))
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
